summary: feat(shared): add tagCriticalEvent and browser compat API to sentry libs
description:
Because:
- FXA-14700 and FXA-14701 need tagCriticalEvent and a browser compat API in the shared Sentry libs.
- The API must land first so those changes only update imports.

This commit:
- Adds tagCriticalEvent and CRITICAL_ENDPOINTS to sentry-utils, copied unchanged from fxa-shared.
- Adds tracesSampler and skipOpenTelemetrySetup (type-only) to SentryConfigOpts.
- Adds browserTracingIntegration to sentry-browser when a trace sample option is set.
- Adds a default export to sentry-browser: configure, captureException, enable, disable.
- Runs tagCriticalEvent before beforeSendServer in sentry-node.

Closes FXA-10670
